root.label: Multiple and virtual inheritance
root.note: One subobject per non-virtual base; one shared subobject per virtual base.

children.label: Pointer adjustment
children.note: A base pointer points at a subobject, often at a different address.

children.label: static_cast adjusts
children.note: Implicit and static conversions add or subtract the base offset; null stays null.

children.label: reinterpret_cast does not
children.note: C* from a second-base B* still points at the B; using it as a C is undefined.

children.label: Comparison converts
children.note: pb == &c converts &c to B* first, so it is true for the same object.

children.label: void* round trips
children.note: Cast back only to the exact type you stored.

children.label: Name lookup
children.note: Lookup merges results from every base before overload resolution.

children.label: Ambiguity
children.note: A name found in two different base subobjects is ill-formed to use.

children.label: Qualify or using
children.note: d.Reader::put picks one; two using-declarations make them overload.

children.label: Same entity is fine
children.note: Static members, types and enumerators found via several paths are not ambiguous.

children.label: Dominance
children.note: With a shared virtual base, a derived declaration wins over the base's.

children.label: The diamond
children.note: Two paths to the same base class.

children.label: Non-virtual
children.note: Two Top subobjects; converting Bottom* to Top* is ambiguous.

children.label: Virtual
children.note: One shared Top; its constructor runs once.

children.label: Unique final overrider
children.note: If two paths override a shared base's virtual, the most derived must override too.

children.label: Virtual base initialization
children.note: The most derived class owns the shared base's construction.

children.label: Intermediates ignored
children.note: Mem-initializers for a virtual base run only in the most derived constructor.

children.label: Default otherwise
children.note: If the most derived class omits it, the base is default-initialized or ill-formed.

children.label: Constructed first
children.note: Virtual bases precede all non-virtual bases, depth-first and left to right.

children.label: Casts across the graph
children.note: Which cast can navigate which edge.

children.label: No static downcast
children.note: static_cast from a virtual base to a derived class is ill-formed.

children.label: dynamic_cast cross-cast
children.note: Moves sideways from A* to B* inside the same most derived object.

children.label: dynamic_cast to void*
children.note: Returns the address of the most derived object.

children.label: Distinct addresses
children.note: Two subobjects of the same type never share an address, limiting EBO.

children.label: Layout (ABI practice)
children.note: Itanium ABI details, not standard guarantees.

children.label: Primary base
children.note: The first non-virtual polymorphic base sits at offset zero and shares the vptr.

children.label: Thunks
children.note: Secondary vtable slots adjust this before jumping to the override.

children.label: Virtual base offset
children.note: Stored in the vtable and loaded at run time; MSVC uses a vbptr instead.
